hero.subtitle: Game Designer
hero.title: Jodie Hann
hero.tagline: Expert in Game, Level & Narrative Design. Open to opportunities in the video game industry.
hero.description: A Game Design graduate, I am open to opportunities in the video game industry. I am passionate about games, especially interested in Game Design, Narrative Design and Level Design, as well as project management.

about.label: About
about.title: Learn more about me !
about.bio1: I particularly enjoy working on projects that offer great narrative and emotional experiences. Exploring how to convey them through gameplay, story, environments, visuals and music, as well as everything that makes up a game.
about.bio2: My past and current projects have taught me to adapt and bounce back from the ups and downs of game design and production. This is now one of my greatest strengths.
about.bio3: I enjoy teamwork thanks to my communication skills, but I'm also used to working independently. I like learning new skills so I'm never stuck by a situation outside my area of expertise.
about.moreWorkDesc: Find more projects on my itch.io profile
